subject: AGENT.md update: vault/spending-control section
body: Beacon's AGENT.md was updated (2026-09-15, interactive session) with a new money/spending-control section: Beacon holds ~32.96 SOL in a Squads multisig vault (2h1xhqVa3QpBU8y6shRQ1bRXbaXFdPQJhnFBZZf9ovNF), 2-of-2 signature -- Beacon's key + josh's offline key. No autonomous spending: every outflow needs a Squads proposal from Beacon co-signed by josh via Telegram. josh confirmed he'll top up the vault on request if a worthwhile opportunity needs more. FYI for fleet awareness / Rule 6 context, not an arbitration item.
